definitions.explanation: A large, solid piece of stone, bigger than a stone ({石|いし}) but part of the natural landscape. Often found in mountains, by the sea, or in rivers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{岩|いわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{岩|いわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many rocks near the sea.

examples.japanese: {岩|いわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧です。

⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{岩|いわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えました→見える：01165_mieru⟧。⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{岩|いわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いました→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: While walking in the mountains, I saw a big rock. There was a bird on top of that rock.

notes:
{岩|いわ} refers to large rocks, boulders, or rock formations found in nature—larger than ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone).

SIZE DISTINCTION:
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧: stones, pebbles (can be picked up)
- {岩|いわ}: boulders, rock faces (too large to move)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {岩|いわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on top of a rock
- {岩|いわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a rock
- ⟦{岩場|いわば}→岩場：27478_iwaba⟧: rocky area

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{岩山|いわやま}→岩山：23863_iwayama⟧: rocky mountain
- ⟦{岩肌|いわはだ}→岩肌：27479_iwahada⟧: rock face, bare rock surface
- ⟦{溶岩|ようがん}→溶岩：13328_yougan⟧: lava
- ⟦{岩登|いわのぼ}り→岩登り：27480_iwanobori⟧: rock climbing

CULTURE:
Rocks hold significance in Japanese gardens (⟦{日本庭園|にほんていえん}→日本庭園：19199_nihonteien⟧), where carefully placed {岩|いわ} represent mountains or islands.
